clue.text: Bed starts me nodding

indicators.note: nodding heads bob about, so the letters of starts and me are jostled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone describes how they begin to doze off in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nodding' rearranges STARTS ME into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A padded base you sleep on is the main part of a bed, and the word can stand for the bed itself.

clue.text: God initially had a lot to arrange

parts.note: Mars is the Roman god of war

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of each of had, a and lot is taken

explanation.surface: A deity at first had plenty to sort out.
explanation.definitionFit: To marshal troops or facts is to set them in order.

clue.text: To Indians it was symbolic to beat the French

parts.note: taken as written
tempo is the beat or pace of music
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Native Americans saw meaning in defeating the French.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition refers to the carved emblem posts of Native American peoples of the Pacific Northwest.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved post displaying clan emblems held symbolic meaning for Native American peoples.

clue.text: They are used to produce curls and waves

definitions.text: They are used to produce curls

explanation.definitionFit: Hair curlers are cylinders that make curls; long heavy swells breaking on a shore are another name for big waves.

clue.text: Set cross up in position

indicators.note: in means the reversed cross goes inside the word for position

parts.note: a site is a position or location

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for cross is read from the bottom

parts.note: a tau cross is T-shaped, named after the Greek letter

explanation.surface: Someone places an angry person in position.
explanation.walkthrough: A tau cross is T-shaped, after the Greek letter; in a down clue 'up' reads it from the bottom, and 'in' places that inside the word for position.
explanation.definitionFit: To set something somewhere is to place or locate it, a synonym.

clue.text: Not out of business, but shaky

parts.note: a batsman who is not out in cricket is still in
a firm is a business or company

explanation.surface: A trader who has not yet gone bust but is wobbling financially.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not out' is the cricket idea of a batsman still in.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone shaky on their feet is frail or weak, a synonym.

clue.text: Fretful and naughty child, one under canvas

annotationWithheld.why: Fretful and naughty child, one under canvas (9): IMP + I in TENT gives IMPTIENT; the A of IMPATIENT has no clue word, unless 'one' gives both A and I, a word doing two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: Fretful and naughty child, one under canvas

clue.text: Promised one to introduce new capital

indicators.note: to introduce means the word for promised one takes the letter for new inside it

parts.note: a fiance is a man promised in marriage

explanation.surface: An engaged partner brings in fresh money.
explanation.definitionFit: Money or capital for a venture is its finance, a synonym.

clue.text: Reply in a note I mail

indicators.note: in means I and the word for mail go inside the word for a note

parts.note: re is a note of the sol-fa scale
post is mail

explanation.surface: Someone answers by posting a written note.
explanation.definitionFit: A quick, sharp retort is a reply, a synonym.

clue.text: Talk about some banger

parts.note: to rattle on is to talk at length

indicators.note: about signals the word for some is turned round

parts.note: part means some of something

explanation.surface: People chatting about a sausage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns PART into TRAP. A banger is British slang for a battered old car (and also a sausage, which the surface uses).
explanation.definitionFit: A rickety noisy old car and a decrepit jalopy are the same thing, a synonym.

clue.text: Emphatic refusal to participate in American Open

indicators.note: the letters take part in, sitting inside, the words American Open

explanation.surface: Someone flatly declines to play in a US tennis tournament.
explanation.definitionFit: A curt informal way of saying no is a firm refusal.

clue.text: Used by blacksmith with great energy

explanation.definitionFit: Literally the smith's striking tool and gripping pliers; idiomatically, going at something vigorously and noisily.

clue.text: Beauty starts to expect envious inspection

parts.note: good looks means beauty

indicators.note: starts means the opening letters of the next words are taken

explanation.surface: A beauty begins to expect jealous glances.
explanation.definitionFit: A quick look-see is informal for a brief examination or inspection.

clue.text: I lead riot, failing as a leader

indicators.note: failing means falling apart, so the letters of I lead riot are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rebel admits that his uprising has fizzled out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'failing' rearranges I LEAD RIOT. A leader is a newspaper's leading article giving the paper's opinion.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper's opinion column is called its leading article, so a leader.

clue.text: Painted lady brought low by Jehu

definitions.text: Painted lady brought low by Jehu

parts.words: Painted lady brought low by Jehu
parts.note: the Old Testament queen who painted her face and was thrown from a window on the orders of King Jehu

explanation.walkthrough: 'Painted lady' sounds like a butterfly; the Book of Kings tells of the queen who painted her eyes before Jehu had her thrown down.
explanation.definitionFit: The Biblical queen of Ahab became a byword for a shameless made-up woman.

clue.text: Contract between two parties both later break

indicators.note: break means smash up, so the letters of both later are rearranged

explanation.surface: Two parties to an agreement both later break it off.
explanation.definitionFit: An engagement to marry is a formal agreement made by two people.

clue.text: Succeed in giving quiet clergyman trouble

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
Rev is short for a reverend, a clergyman
to ail is to trouble or afflict

explanation.surface: Someone wins by causing a hushed vicar problems.
explanation.definitionFit: To win through or triumph means to succeed.

clue.text: Burden for bear, in a word

explanation.walkthrough: Burden is an old word for a song's chorus; 'for bear' run together as one word gives forbear, to hold back.
explanation.definitionFit: A song's burden is its recurring chorus; forbear means hold back, also the sense of the verb.

clue.text: Gallant vessel about to tack the other way

indicators.note: about means the word for vessel goes round the rest

parts.note: a vat is a large vessel

indicators.note: the other way means the word for tack is read in reverse

parts.note: a tack is a small nail

explanation.surface: A sailing ship is about to change course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the other way' turns NAIL into LIAN, which VAT goes 'about'.
explanation.definitionFit: Brave and heroic, the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Cloud getting right into position

indicators.note: into means the letter for right is placed inside the word for position

parts.note: status is one's position or standing

explanation.surface: Someone under a cloud is finding their way back into standing.
explanation.definitionFit: A low, flat grey sheet of cloud is a type of cloud formation.

clue.text: A private room can and must get organized

indicators.note: get organized means be put in order, so the letters of can and must are rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction to tidy a private room.
explanation.definitionFit: An inner sanctum is a private retreat or study.

clue.text: Emperor and knight put up the fare

indicators.note: in a down clue, put up means the pair of words is read upwards

parts.note: Otto was the name of several Holy Roman Emperors
Sir is a knight's title

explanation.surface: An emperor and a knight serve up the meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' turns OTTO SIR into RIS OTTO.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian rice dish is a type of food, so fare.

clue.text: The raising of glasses is in doubt

indicators.note: in a down clue raising means the word for glasses is read from the bottom up

parts.note: specs is short for spectacles, glasses

explanation.surface: Whether toasts will be made is uncertain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The raising of' turns SPECS into SCEPS.
explanation.definitionFit: Philosophical scepticism or doubt is the meaning of this rare word.

clue.text: The rest of one's face will go straight forward

definitions.text: The rest of one's face will

explanation.walkthrough: The first half is a playful literal reading: the rest of your face comes along behind your nose.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally, the face trails the nose; idiomatically, to proceed straight ahead or by instinct.

clue.text: A foreign lawyer to thank for this information

parts.note: DA, a district attorney, is an American lawyer
ta is British informal for thank you

explanation.surface: An overseas attorney is owed gratitude for passing on facts.
explanation.walkthrough: DA (district attorney) is American, hence 'foreign'; TA is British slang for thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: Facts and figures collected for use are information, a synonym.

clue.text: Extremely tickled this month by tickling sensations

parts.note: inst. (instant) is the old business abbreviation for this month
itches are tickling sensations on the skin

explanation.surface: Someone has been bothered all month by prickly feelings.
explanation.walkthrough: INST. (instant) was business-letter shorthand for 'of this month'.
explanation.definitionFit: Being helpless with laughter means being greatly amused, idiom.

clue.text: Gradually introduce witness trial proceeding evenly

indicators.note: evenly means the even-numbered letters, second, fourth and so on, are taken from witness trial

explanation.surface: A court case moves smoothly while a witness is brought in.
explanation.definitionFit: To instil an idea is to implant it little by little, a synonym.

clue.text: Order Paul some doses of medicine

indicators.note: order as a verb means arrange, so the letters of Paul some are rearranged

explanation.surface: Paul is told to get some medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: Small sealed glass vials hold single injectable measures of a drug, standing for the doses themselves.
